title: Identify the ID of the male patient older than 60 with abnormal albumin lev
question: Identify the ID of the male patient older than 60 with abnormal albumin levels who also has a normal creatinine level and the highest anti-Cardiolipin IgA concentration among such patients.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_058"
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060")) > 60
  AND T2."XCL_031" < 3.5
  AND T2."XCL_056" < 1.5
ORDER BY T2."XCL_024" DESC
LIMIT 1
